name: ZX_TRX_LINE_APP_REGIMES
description: This table stores Transaction Line aplicable Regimes

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code of the transaction

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_ID
columns.description: Tax regime identifier applicable for the transaction line

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code applicable for the transaction line

columns.name: TAX_PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier of the third party tax service provider that calculates tax for this regime and transaction line

columns.name: ALLOW_TAX_CALCULATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates to the tax service provider to always synchronize the transaction and tax information instead of calculating the tax information

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the transaction line is updated in the current API call

columns.name: PSEUDO_TAX_ONLY_LINE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the transaction line identifier represents a pseudo line corresponding to a tax only line
